_doc: 0.8. The narrative layer, from lore.md. 'missions' are the five Act I investigations - THE NAMES OF THE DEAD - one to a district. They are never accepted and never expire: each is a rumour until the survivor sets foot on one of its two sites, an investigation until one of its two pieces of evidence has been seen (either is enough; both corroborate), then it wants only that the survivor gets out alive, and finally a decision about who is given the proof. Progress is kept on the profile through death. 'storyXpShare' is the share of the experience needed to reach 'storyXpRank' that each mission pays, once. 'contracts' are the ten jobs on the board: ordinary paid work, each a different kind of task for a different reason, none of them a step in a mission. A contract comes back to the board 'contractCooldown' operations after it is completed; its pay grows with Rank (base x (1 + rank / 25)).

raiders.label: Sell it to the Rail Yard Crew

missions.title: The Roll Call
missions.rumour: A grocery Downtown still keeps ration records for families who were evacuated years ago. The police archive holds a roll that says otherwise. Somebody is trading on the identity card of a household that is supposed to be dead.
missions.investigate: Search the Meridian Fresh Market for the ration ledger, or the Central Police Headquarters for the evacuation roll. Either is proof; together they cannot be argued with.
missions.extract: You have seen it. Get out of the Zone alive with what you know.
missions.discovery: The bureaucracy counted living residents as gone. A ration delivery dated after the official evacuation carries a name the roll had already erased.
missions.question: Who made people disappear on paper?

readings.military: The Military wants unauthorized documents secured.
readings.survivors: The shelters want names put back on the ration lists.
readings.raiders: The Rail Yard Crew wants addresses - and which households are worth a visit.

outcomes.survivors: Names go back on the ration lists at Saint Agnes.
outcomes.military: The cordon tightens round Downtown: the roll is now a restricted document.
outcomes.mercenaries: Halberd files it under recovered property. A client somewhere is told.
outcomes.raiders: The crew has a list of addresses. Some of those doors will be kicked in.
outcomes.keep: The ledger stays with you. The households stay erased.

missions.title: The Room with the Light On
missions.rumour: One upstairs room on a dark Residential street still has its light on. Medicine marked P-12 keeps arriving at a house that was vacated years ago. The nurse, Iryna, is missing.
missions.investigate: Search the Whitcombe House for the dosage notebook, or the Halloran Mansion for the patient records kept behind its service route.
missions.extract: You know what the house was for. Get out alive.
missions.discovery: The house was an off-books observation annex. What was called care was monitoring, and the consent was not consent.
missions.question: Why were residents studied at home?

readings.mercenaries: Halberd calls it an inventory discrepancy.
readings.military: The Military suspects illegal medical stock.
readings.survivors: The shelters want the nurse, and what she knew about treatment.
readings.raiders: The crew expects drugs, and whatever the estate still has in its drawers.

outcomes.survivors: Dr. Hrytsenko has the dosage notes. The shelter's care gets a little better.
outcomes.military: The street is closed by order. The light goes out.
outcomes.mercenaries: The supply route is Halberd's now, and so is whatever still comes down it.
outcomes.raiders: The estate is stripped within the week.
outcomes.keep: The notebook stays in your case. The light is still on.

missions.title: The Empty Transfer
missions.rumour: Blackmoor's paperwork lists detainees discharged to medical care. None of them reached a hospital. The bus movements line up with fuel receipts at the Aldous Farm and a freight siding that runs toward Industrial.
missions.investigate: Search the Blackmoor Correctional Complex for the transfer ledger, or the Aldous Farm for the weighbills that match it.
missions.extract: You know where the buses went. Get out alive.
missions.discovery: "Medical transfer" meant supplying subjects. Payments to a private intermediary tie the prisoner economy to corporate procurement - and some of the prisoners were civilians whose names had already been erased.
missions.question: Where did the prisoners go?

readings.mercenaries: Halberd wants a missing cargo code.
readings.military: The Military demands the official ledger.
readings.survivors: The shelters are looking for relatives who disappeared.
readings.raiders: The crew wants the route, and the cache that vanished along it.

outcomes.survivors: The names are read out at Saint Agnes. Some families have an answer.
outcomes.military: The ledger is surrendered. The freight corridor gets a checkpoint.
outcomes.mercenaries: The destination is sold. Somebody else will get there first.
outcomes.raiders: The Kerosene Boys run the corridor now, and charge for it.
outcomes.keep: The route is your leverage, for whenever you need it.

missions.title: Silence on the Airfield
missions.rumour: The airfield repeater alternates between an announcement that the evacuation is proceeding and an order to remain indoors. The departure boards and the baggage are still there, behind the cordon.
missions.investigate: Search the Municipal Airfield for the passenger gate list, or Fort Lindqvist for the dispatch log of the broadcasts.
missions.extract: You have the timestamps. Get out alive.
missions.discovery: The flight was marked evacuated before its departure was cancelled. A private procurement channel helped order the halt. It was not a malfunction.
missions.question: Who controlled the official story?

readings.mercenaries: Halberd is after private contractor communications.
readings.military: The Military wants contradictory signals contained.
readings.survivors: The shelters want the truth about a flight that never left.
readings.raiders: The crew wants working authorization codes.

outcomes.survivors: The proof goes out on the shelter's radio. People stop waiting for the flight.
outcomes.military: It goes up the chain. Capt. Belova reads it twice.
outcomes.mercenaries: Sold. The repeater keeps saying both things.
outcomes.raiders: The codes open a gate that was never meant to open again.
outcomes.keep: You hold it for bargaining. In the old recording, under the voice, something pulses.

missions.title: The Second Inventory
missions.rumour: A plant that is supposed to be dead still draws power. Cleanup crews are moving tagged equipment out of an annex of the laboratory. There are two inventories: A, and one that lists rooms that never officially existed.
missions.investigate: Search the Helix Research Laboratory for Inventory B, or the Power Plant for the copied service diagram.
missions.extract: You have read the instruction. Get out alive.
missions.discovery: Inventory B ties the grocery's erased households, the P-12 house, the Barrens transfers and the cancelled departures together. The name is PROJECT VEIL. One instruction reads: "When preservation is no longer possible, enact secondary containment. All records are to remain inside Absentialis."
missions.question: What is "secondary containment"?

readings.mercenaries: Halberd wants a missing corporate asset list.
readings.military: The Military wants its emergency equipment accounted for.
readings.survivors: The shelters want the discharge and patient links.
readings.raiders: The crew wants fuel, electronics and a storeroom with a code on its door.

outcomes.survivors: VEIL has a name in the shelters now. It will not be un-said.
outcomes.military: Surrendered to the authorities. Col. Morozov signs for it himself.
outcomes.mercenaries: The records are sold back to the people who wrote them.
outcomes.raiders: Facility access changes hands for fuel.
outcomes.keep: A copy is safe with you. All records were to remain inside Absentialis. One has not.

contracts.title: The Ration Line
contracts.desc: Saint Agnes is feeding people the lists say do not exist. Extract with 3 cans of stew; they are taken from your stash when you are back.

contracts.title: The Pump Road
contracts.desc: The clean water is at the end of a street nobody can walk. Kill 8 infected in Residential.

contracts.title: Somebody's Neighbour
contracts.desc: Olena wants people brought in, not counted. Get 2 wounded strangers back on their feet, anywhere in the Zone.

contracts.title: Rail Yard Sweep
contracts.desc: The 3rd Cordon Battalion wants the freight track quiet. Neutralise 3 Bandits in the Barrens. They will remember.

contracts.title: Permit Survey
contracts.desc: The permit maps are nine years old. Walk 40 new map cells of Munincipal and extract with the survey.

contracts.title: Lights for the Checkpoint
contracts.desc: A checkpoint that cannot see shoots first. Restore power at a district substation.

contracts.title: Paper for Halberd
contracts.desc: The client pays for paper and does not say why. Recover and read 2 documents anywhere in the Zone.

contracts.title: Specimen
contracts.desc: Elias Mercer wants one of the changed ones confirmed dead: a Tank, a Spewer, a Bomber, the Butcher or a Gladiator. Any one. Anywhere.

contracts.title: Past the Cordon
contracts.desc: Kerosene wants to know the track is still open. Deploy into the Barrens and get out alive by any route. The cordon is not to know.

contracts.title: Shake the Lockers
contracts.desc: Cole Briggs wants to know what the cleanup crews left behind. Search 10 containers in Industrial.

story.ration_ledger.name: Ration Ledger
story.ration_ledger.text: MERIDIAN FRESH MARKET - RATION ISSUE. Household 14-C, Bereza: four persons, issued weekly. The last entry is dated eleven weeks after the evacuation was declared complete. In the margin, in pencil: "N. says they are still on Canal Street. Do not strike."

story.evacuation_roll.name: Evacuation Roll
story.evacuation_roll.text: CENTRAL POLICE HEADQUARTERS - ARCHIVE. EVACUATION ROLL, SECTOR 14. Household 14-C, Bereza: four persons. Status: EVACUATED. Stamped and countersigned the same morning the buses were turned back. Registrar: N. Bereza. Her own name is on her own list.

story.p12_notebook.name: Dosage Notebook
story.p12_notebook.text: A nurse's hand. "P-12, 0.4 ml, 06:00 and 18:00. Subject is told it is for the cough. Observe: sleep, appetite, whether she asks to leave. She asked again today. I said the roads were closed. - Iryna." The last pages are torn out.

story.patient_records.name: Patient Records
story.patient_records.text: HALLORAN - SERVICE WING. Eleven cards. Each has an address on the same street, a code beginning P-, and a line for consent that is signed by somebody else. The top card reads: "Annex 3 (the Whitcombe house): continue. Family not to be informed."

story.transfer_ledger.name: Transfer Ledger
story.transfer_ledger.text: BLACKMOOR CORRECTIONAL - DISCHARGES. Thirty-one names, each "discharged to medical care". No hospital is named. Seven of the names have no booking number at all: they were never prisoners. Beside the total, a payment reference to an intermediary, and a gate: "H-LAB / N".

story.farm_weighbill.name: Farm Weighbills
story.farm_weighbill.text: ALDOUS FARM - FUEL AND WEIGHBRIDGE. A bus refuelled here every Thursday, heavier going out than coming back. "Paid in cash. Driver does not get out. Siding crew signs for the load as LIVESTOCK." The farm has not kept livestock in nine years.

story.gate_list.name: Passenger Gate List
story.gate_list.text: ABSENTIALIS MUNICIPAL AIRFIELD - GATE 2. Flight marked DEPARTED - EVACUATED at 05:40. Passengers checked through: 212. The same sheet, lower down, in another pen: "Departure cancelled 06:15 by order. Passengers to be returned to sector." It was reported gone before it was stopped.

story.broadcast_log.name: Dispatch Log
story.broadcast_log.text: FORT LINDQVIST - DISPATCH. 05:38 broadcast A: "Evacuation is proceeding. Go to your assigned gate." 06:16 broadcast B: "Remain indoors." Authorisation for B is not a military call sign. It is a procurement account. Under the 06:16 recording there is a slow pulse, like machinery.

story.inventory_b.name: Inventory B
story.inventory_b.text: HELIX RESEARCH LABORATORY - INVENTORY B. Rooms that are not on the plans. Subjects received from "H-LAB / N". Agent P-12, issued to Annex 3. Household numbers. Flight manifests. Project name: VEIL. Final line: "When preservation is no longer possible, enact secondary containment. All records are to remain inside Absentialis."

story.service_diagram.name: Copied Service Diagram
story.service_diagram.text: ABSENTIALIS POWER STATION - SERVICE DIAGRAM (COPY). The plant is listed as cold. The diagram shows a feed that is not: one line, drawn in by hand, running under the laboratory to a room marked only "B". A technician has written beside it: "It never went off. - K. Danylchuk"
